data_facts_with_vis_data_meta.paragraph: On February 10, as part of its mission to “maximize government efficiency,” the Trump administration announced its cancellation of roughly $1 billion in federal contracts for education research. These contracts were held under the Institute of Education Sciences (IES)—the research, statistics, and evaluation arm of the U.S. Department of Education, which was created as part of the Education Sciences Reform Act (ESRA) of 2002.�a0The contracts affect organizations and individuals all across the United States and impact our ability to monitor the global competitiveness of our students.
